entities.summary: The Pakistan Military Academy (PMA) is a military training institution for cadets seeking a commission in the Pakistan Army. Located in Kakul, Abbottabad, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan, it was established in November 1947. The academy is accredited by the National University of Sciences and Technology (NUST).
